P0.description: Urgent patch work selected during developer review

P1.description: Fix an existing patch on a supported app version, assigned during developer review

P2.description: Requested feature or app version support, assigned during developer review

P3.description: Optional change or deferred update notice, assigned during developer review

bug.description: Patching, installation or app behavior fails

enhancement.description: New feature for a supported app

app request.description: Request to support a new app

app-update.description: New app version to assess for support

regression.description: Previously worked with an older patches release on the same app version

confirmed.description: Developer reproduced the reported bug on a supported app version

needs info.description: Waiting for missing details from the reporter

incomplete.description: Report failed validation, used by triage to reassess edits

untargeted version.description: Reported app version is outside the declared targets

in progress.description: Work has started on this issue or request

in pre-release.description: Change is available in a dev release and awaits stable release

no-stale.description: Exempt from inactivity closure and automatic locking

bot-wrong.description: Pause automated triage and replies for this item

duplicate.description: Same report or request already has another thread

other bundle.description: Patch or matching request belongs to another bundle

server-side.description: Requested behavior depends on server enforcement

upstream.description: Cause belongs to Manager, patcher or download routing

protection:app-antitamper.description: App-specific signing or integrity checks identified

protection:ijiami.description: Ijiami packing or runtime protection identified

protection:jiagu.description: 360 Jiagu packing or runtime protection identified

protection:ollvm.description: OLLVM obfuscation identified in native code

protection:pairip.description: PairIP licensing or code virtualization identified

protection:play-integrity.description: App uses Google Play Integrity attestation

protection:secshell.description: SecShell packing or runtime protection identified
